item.title: Bowen: Trump has called for an Iran uprising but the lessons from Iraq in 1991 loom large
item.summary: The US president might learn that starting wars is much easier than ending them, writes the BBC's international editor.

item.title: Countries agree to record release of emergency oil reserves as prices surge
item.summary: The G7 group of nations welcomes the idea of releasing oil in response to the surge in prices since the US-Israel war with Iran began

item.title: 'Even under missiles we carry on living' - how young Iranians are coping with war
item.summary: Iranians say they are sheltering at home and rarely venturing out on near-empty streets as the US-Israeli bombing campaign continues.

item.title: EU and UK demand Israel stop surge in West Bank settler violence since Iran war
item.summary: Six Palestinians have been killed during attacks by settlers in the West Bank since the start of Israel's war, the UN says.

item.title: Ukraine says it has hit Russian 'missile component' plant
item.summary: Russia says the attack hit civilians and could not have been carried out without British help.

item.title: French aid worker among three killed in drone strikes in rebel-held DR Congo city
item.summary: Witnesses say drone strikes hit a residential building frequently occupied by expatriates and aid workers in Goma.

item.title: Acclaimed Peruvian writer Alfredo Bryce Echenique dies aged 87
item.summary: The author is best known for his novel A World for Julius, which chronicles the frivolous lives of the elite.

item.title: Member of Iranian football delegation granted Australian asylum changes her mind
item.summary: One of the seven women who received visas has reversed her decision after speaking to teammates, minister says

item.title: Large WW2 bomb defused after Dresden evacuated
item.summary: The city's biggest ever evacuation comes after the British flying bomb was discovered near a collapsed bridge.

item.title: Woman charged with attempted murder after shooting at Rihanna's home
item.summary: The woman posted about the singer online prior to the attack, the BBC's US news partner CBS reports.
